options.name: action
options.description: Specifies which action needs to be performed. C(list_versions) lists the available timezone versions and the current version; C(update_timezone) updates the timezone database; C(print_updated_zones) prints the updated zones from the system; C(update_timezone_offline) updates timezone using the provided timezone DB;

options.name: db_location
options.description: Specifies the location of tar ball containg timezone DB. This needs be provided with I(action=update_timezone_offline) Only works when I(action=update_timezone_offline) is set

options.name: timezone
options.description: Specifies the timezone database that the system needs to be updated to. Required for I(action=update_timezone).
